newsitem.title: USA: Grove Real Estate completes consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Grove Real Estate completes consolidation.

text.p: Grove Real Estate Trust said on Friday it has completed its consolidation plan for converting its Grove partnerships into new equity.
As part of the consolidation, it raised $30 million in a common stock offering, the company said.
The company will pay a dividend of $0.184 a share to shareholders of record on March 10, 1997 for the period from January 1, 1997 through March 13, Grove said.
Shareholders of record on March 10, 1997 will also receive a five percent stock grant and a stock split of 1.125 shares for every share of Grove Real Estate, the company said.
The company originally announced the dividend and stock split on March 4.
